latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of CreditClaw skill for agent-enabled online shopping and payments.

- Lets agents shop online with guardrailed wallets, spending controls, and owner approval.
- Supports multiple payment methods: Pre-paid Wallet (Amazon, Shopify), Self-Hosted Card (SaaS, cloud, any store), and Stripe x402 Wallet (on-chain, agent-to-agent).
- Clear setup instructions for registration, API use, and file management.
- Per-method purchasing guides and security best practices included.
- Strong security measures: server-side guardrails, spending enforcement, approval modes, and rate limits.
- Real-time owner visibility and control over all agent purchases.
